sub_parameters.name: AliUid
sub_parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account UID of the member.

sub_parameters.name: AntiRansomwareCapacity
sub_parameters.description: The anti-ransomware capacity assigned to the member. Unit: GB.

sub_parameters.name: ChargeType
sub_parameters.description:
The billing type. Valid values:
* **PREPAID**: upfront.
* **POSTPAID** (default): pay-as-you-go.

sub_parameters.name: CspmCapacity
sub_parameters.description: The number of cloud platform configuration check scans assigned to the member. Unit: scans per month.

sub_parameters.name: HoneypotCapacity
sub_parameters.description: The number of honeypot quotas assigned to the member.

sub_parameters.name: ImageScanCapacity
sub_parameters.description: The number of image scan quotas assigned to the member.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The Security Center instance ID purchased by the member accounts.

sub_parameters.name: OptType
sub_parameters.description:
The operation type. Valid values:  
- **ADD**: increase 
- **CHANGE**: update
- **DEL**: delete

sub_parameters.name: RaspCapacity
sub_parameters.description: The number of application protection quotas assigned to the member. Unit: quotas per month.

sub_parameters.name: SdkCapacity
sub_parameters.description: The number of malicious file detection SDK quotas assigned to the member.

sub_parameters.name: SlsCapacity
sub_parameters.description: The log storage capacity assigned to the member. Unit: GB.

sub_parameters.name: Status
sub_parameters.description:
The instance status of the member accounts. Valid values:
- **1**: active.
- **2**: expired.

sub_parameters.name: ThreatAnalysisCapacity
sub_parameters.description: The threat analysis capacity assigned to the member. Unit: GB.

sub_parameters.name: ThreatAnalysisFlow
sub_parameters.description: The log ingestion traffic for threat detection and response assigned to the member. Unit: GB/day.

sub_parameters.name: Version
sub_parameters.description:
The Security Center edition to bind. Valid values:  
- **1**: Free Edition 
- **3**: Enterprise Edition
- **5**: Advanced Edition
- **6**: Anti-virus Edition    
- **7**: Ultimate Edition

sub_parameters.name: VersionSummary
sub_parameters.description: The authorization usage information of the member accounts.

sub_parameters.name: WebLockCapacity
sub_parameters.description: The number of web tamper-proofing authorization quotas assigned to the member.
